The combination of price reaching extreme bands with ATR confirming volatility regime helps avoid false signals during low volatility periods.

Adding RSI as a momentum filter helps avoid entering trades during extreme overbought/oversold conditions where mean-reversion is less reliable. The Bollinger Band signals provide clear entry levels while ATR ensures dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels that adapt to volatility.
